en.text: The growth rate of real GDP is smaller than that of nominal GDP during deflation.

zh.text: 在通貨緊縮期間，實質本地生產總值的增長率小於名義本地生產總值的增長率。

en.text: Real GDP and nominal GDP will increase simultaneously only during inflation.

zh.text: 只有在通貨膨脹期間，實質本地生產總值和名義本地生產總值才會同時增加。

en.text: When the growth rate of nominal GDP is smaller than the inflation rate, real GDP decreases.

zh.text: 當名義本地生產總值的增長率小於通脹率時，實質本地生產總值便會下降。

en.text: Nominal GDP is equal to real GDP only in the base year.

zh.text: 只有在基準年，名義本地生產總值才等於實質本地生產總值。
